name: flyto-plugins-js
description: Flyto2 JavaScript and TypeScript plugin SDK for workflow automation, interactive UI steps, and human-in-the-loop AI agents.
author: Flyto2 (https://flyto2.com)

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.lint: npm run build --workspace @flyto2/plugin-sdk && npm run lint --workspaces --if-present
